verification_warning.heading: Verification warning
verification_warning.intro: Choose when OSL reminds you to check that a person is really who they say they are.
verification_warning.option_every_time_effect: OSL reminds you to check this person every time you open the chat.
verification_warning.option_once_effect: OSL reminds you the first time you open the chat, then stays quiet.
verification_warning.option_before_sending_effect: OSL reminds you just before you send, not when you open the chat.
verification_warning.option_never_effect: OSL never reminds you. You can still check a person yourself at any time.
verification_warning.state_unsaved_template: Not saved yet. Reset puts this back to {choice}.
